summary: This guide covers four optimized teams and variations for Week 2 of Continental Challenge against Vasska, Twitch, Khrysos, and Tamar. For Vasska, a Frost/Necrosis team utilizes Fitz's ultimate to absorb undispellable Attack penalties alongside Voresh's Buff Prohibition. The Twitch encounter is tackled using a high-Resistance Radiance Aura team that capitalizes on stage damage buffs triggered by resisting debuffs. Against Khrysos, a Lightning Dauntless team stacks Attack Speed and Resistance, while Tamar is countered with a high-damage Toxin team using a manual targeting trick on Lothair.

heroes.name: Fitz
heroes.verdict: Core tank and debuff cleanser for Vasska
heroes.note: Transfers the boss's undispellable Attack penalties from allies to himself using his ultimate.

heroes.name: Voresh
heroes.note: Applies Buff Prohibition to prevent Vasska's Attack and Attack Speed buffs while providing healing and Defense Penalty.

heroes.name: Torrin
heroes.note: Built with high Skill Haste to cycle Puppeteer set buffs on an 18-second rotation while sharing defensive stats with Fitz.

heroes.name: Vidimir
heroes.note: Deals massive damage without needing Accuracy when geared with 100% Critical Rate and high Critical Damage.

heroes.name: Solmo
heroes.note: Built with over 500 Resistance and Titan Rib to provide team-wide shields and damage buffs upon resisting debuffs.

heroes.name: Talethia
heroes.verdict: Top Radiance Aura DPS for Twitch
heroes.note: Scales heavily with Max HP% and Critical stats to deliver the bulk of the Aura team's AoE damage.

heroes.name: Maashtur
heroes.note: Reduces boss Attack and Recharge Speed while providing massive shields and taking damage for allies.

heroes.name: Nathaniel
heroes.note: Epic Lightning support that dispels debuffs, provides shielding with Aurelium Vest, and shares Resistance through talents.

heroes.name: Child of Chaos
heroes.verdict: Core cleanser and buffer for Tamar
heroes.note: Uses the Puppeteer set and high Attack to reliably cleanse crowd control and debuffs from the team.

heroes.name: Lothair
heroes.note: Deals immense damage when geared with Enlightenment and Resistance, especially when manually positioned to avoid boss debuffs.

heroes.name: Serpentemis
heroes.note: Achieves massive scaling with high Enlightenment, Attack, and at least 150 Accuracy.

teams.note: Budget-friendly Frost/Necrosis setup capable of over 200M damage; Fitz absorbs Attack penalties while Voresh prevents boss self-buffs.
Radiance Aura composition stacking high Resistance to quickly cap the stage's 200-stack Attack buff and trigger Titan Rib.
Lightning Dauntless team tuned with Resistance runes to negate Attack Speed debuffs; Nathaniel can replace Maashtur if needed.
High-scoring Toxin team reaching over 1B damage; manually time Lothair's first ultimate to keep him out of Tamar's debuff cone.

tips: Align all skill timings to an 18-second recast interval when triggering the Puppeteer armor set bonus.
Against Twitch and Tamar, build high Resistance (ideally 300+) on your heroes to prevent crippling Attack penalties and trigger bonus stage buffs.
On Tamar, manually trigger Lothair's first ultimate after reaching 40 Poison stacks and aim it away from the center to prevent him from being targeted by Tamar's Attack Penalty II.
Tune Fitz's ultimate cast to 23 seconds on Vasska so he cleanses and redirects the boss's undispellable Attack penalty right before your DPS heroes burst.
